title: Beginning the Journey
content: Today I started building something meaningful. Not for anyone else — for the person I'm becoming. Momentum Corner is not just a website. It's a promise to myself.

title: The Decision
content: Decided to stop drifting. I want a place that grounds me, motivates me, and reminds me who I am. A digital sanctuary that makes me pause before I scroll.

title: What I've Learned
content: The most important skill is consistency. Everything else is noise. Build every day, even if it's imperfect. Show up.

title: Small Win
content: Finished a project I'd been procrastinating on. Felt that rush of completion. I want more of this feeling. Momentum is real.

title: A Hard Truth
content: I've been confusing motion with progress. Being busy is not the same as being effective. Time to cut the noise.
